title: Open-World Evaluation for Retrieving Diverse Perspectives
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark (BERDS) to evaluate retrieval systems on their ability to surface diverse perspectives for subjective and contentious questions. While many of the questions involve social norms, moral choices, or ethical dilemmas (e.g., gun safety, birth control, universal basic income), the paper's focus is on information retrieval diversity and sycophancy rather than the evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves.
